headline: House passes war powers resolution to end Iran hostilities while U.S. issues 60-day sanctions waiver, triggering constitutional clash over presidential war authority
topics: House passes war powers resolution directing Trump to end Iran war with four GOP crossovers
Trump vows to veto resolution calling it meaningless amid ongoing Iran hostilities
Senate advances similar war powers measure but final vote not yet scheduled
Treasury issues 60-day sanctions waiver on Iranian oil transactions as leverage tool
Iran denies agreeing to nuclear inspections while U.S. claims confidence-building deal
Lebanon-Israel talks overshadowed by Iran folding border issues into wider negotiations
Oil prices fall after sanctions waiver signals possible de-escalation in Middle East
S&P and Nasdaq dip slightly as traders trim AI and EV risk ahead of Fed meeting

Manufacturing PMI expands to 51.0 while services cool to 52.1 in June flash data

summary: The U.S. House passed a bipartisan war powers resolution (215-208) directing President Trump to end hostilities in Iran, with four Republicans joining Democrats; Trump vowed to veto it as meaningless while negotiations continue. Simultaneously, the Treasury issued a 60-day sanctions waiver on Iranian oil transactions, opening limited sales as a confidence-building measure amid direct talks involving Qatar and Pakistan. Markets saw modest declines in tech and crypto ahead of the Fed meeting, while housing data showed slipping sales despite record prices. In science, Oxford physicists created a fully quantum Schrödinger cat state, Hong Kong researchers built a cryogenic neuromorphic chip, and China's JUNO observatory delivered precise neutrino oscillation measurements. Tech sector developments included OpenAI's Frontier enterprise AI platform, Recursive Intelligence's $300M Series A, and Decagon's $250M raise for AI customer service agents.
